## How this system powers WelTel's software delivery

By coupling **AWS cloud cost optimization (-30% bill reduction)** with an **AI-driven Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway**, WelTel's engineering stack operates with zero vendor lock-in, automated CI/CD pipelines, and real-time clinical intelligence.

- **DevOps**: Self-hosted AWS EKS runners & multi-AZ VPC layout.
- **AI & MCP**: 42 clinical tools, Google Antigravity & xAI Grok streaming.
- **Mobile**: AWS Amplify GraphQL real-time chat & 5 modernized SMS gateways.

| Infrastructure Area | Metric | Achievement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cloud Infrastructure | $4,000 → $2,800/mo | -30% AWS Monthly Bill Reduction |
| AI Gateway | 42 Tools | Greenfield MCP Protocol Server (~395 commits) |
| Mobile App | 531+ Commits | Production React Native + Amplify GraphQL |
| Platform SMS | 5 Gateways | Refactored deprecated request to Axios |
